subject: Practical success plan and deployment gates for POC
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearforge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Practical success plan and deployment gates for POC

Hi Liam — thanks again for the demo and the deep dive today. Quick recap of what we discussed and the concrete POC plan so everyone has the same expectations. I copied Ben and Soojin to own the test runs and quality evaluation.

Summary of success criteria we propose (first pass):
- Latency: p50 <= 60ms, p95 <= 180ms at your target request size (avg payload ~120 tokens).
- Throughput: sustain 200 reqs/min with 95th percentile tail under 250ms added variance per request.
- Cost: target unit cost < $0.0008 per token for the evaluation workload (we'll provide a cost breakdown by model/quant).
- Quality: automated metrics (task-specific F1/intent accuracy) >= 91% and manual accept-rate >= 90% on a 300-sample human evaluation set.

Proposed POC phases & timeline:
1) Sandbox provisioning (0-5 business days): provide access to a dedicated sandbox and service account.
2) Smoke & baseline (week 1): run lightweight smoke tests, baseline perf and cost.
3) Full evaluation (weeks 2-3): run your sample production traffic (we'll ambiently throttle to match expected cadence), execute quality evals.
4) Readout & gating (end of week 3): review results vs success criteria and decide next steps (scale / pilot / contract).

Owners & asks:
- Ben (ben.carter@redwood.ai) — bench/perf owner: will run load tests, collect latency percentiles, and produce the perf/cost worksheet.
- Soojin (soojin.lee@redwood.ai) — quality lead: will run automated evals and coordinate human annotation.
- Liam / ClearForge — provide a representative sample of production payloads (anonymized) and 300-sample label set for quality checks; share any data residency requirements up front.

Attachments: sample payloads + POC template attached (clearforge_sample_payloads.json, redwood_poc_template.xlsx).

Next steps: if that looks good I can provision the sandbox today and Ben will schedule the bench run early next week.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearforge.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, devops@clearforge.com
Date: Sat, 8 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Practical success plan and deployment gates for POC

Thanks Mina — that plan looks sensible. A few clarification items from our side:

1) Security & compliance: before we share sample payloads we'll need a short checklist confirming where logs/inputs are stored during the sandbox evaluation, plus confirmation that Redwood can exclude any retained PII from analytics. Do you have a one-pager or SOC2 evidence we can review quickly?

2) Data residency: we need the sandbox to be hosted in us-west1 or us-east1. Is that feasible for the dedicated sandbox?

3) For the quality eval: the 300-sample set is doable. We also want a human review rubric that matches our support acceptance criteria — can Soojin propose a short rubric?

Lastly, can Ben share the expected VM/GPU footprint you'll need for the performance targets so our infra team can provision a temp host if needed?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Liam

--
Liam O'Connor
Head of Product, ClearForge
liam.oconnor@clearforge.com | +1 617-555-4420

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearforge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Practical success plan and deployment gates for POC

Thanks Liam — short answers inline below and next actions at the bottom.

1) Security & compliance: we can share a short sandbox security brief (storage retention, telemetry, and PII handling) and our current SOC2 status. I'll attach the one-pager to the shared drive and link it here. Redwood's sandbox does not persist user inputs beyond the evaluation window unless explicitly enabled; we can disable any analytics collection for this test if you prefer.

2) Data residency: yes — we can provision the sandbox in us-west1. Ben will confirm the exact host specs he'll use for bench runs, but we can also accept a ClearForge-provisioned host if you prefer to run tests behind your network boundary.

3) Human review rubric: Soojin will draft a 1-page rubric (pass/fail + severity scale) and circulate by EOD Wednesday.

Provisioning & timeline:
- Today: I will create a sandbox project and share IAM service account keys to devops@clearforge.com (we prefer workspaces + short-lived keys).
- Wed (week 1): Ben runs baseline smoke tests and shares perf/cost sheet.
- Weeks 2-3: Full evaluation (automated + human eval).
- Fri week 3: Joint readout.

Drive & links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBexAMPLEdriveLink (sample payloads and onboarding checklist).

Next actions for owners:
- Ben: confirm host/GPU footprint and run schedule (cc'd).
- Soojin: rubric and plan for the 300-sample human evaluation.
- Liam/devops: confirm you received the sandbox invite and whether you want Redwood-managed hosts or ClearForge-hosted tests.

I'll proceed to provision the sandbox after I hear back on hosting preference.

Best,
Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Quick operational note: I'll run the initial bench on Wed morning (08:00-12:00 PT). Planned host footprint for the targets above (estimate):
- 2x A10G or equivalent GPUs (single-tenant) for initial bench — should hit the latency/throughput targets on aggregated request patterns.
- If we need lower p95 tails at scale we'll look at a 4x GPU config or model-quantization variants.

Action for ClearForge: if you can send a short script that replays requests at production intervals (example format attached: load_test_script.sh) it'll speed up the process. I'll post results and the perf/cost worksheet to the shared drive same day.

Ben
